messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — genqueue-high-latency triggered (P1). 5xx spike from eu-west nodes. Alert: https://alerts.example/GENQUEUE-12345. Please ack and start on-call flow.
Priya: acked, I'm on it. Seeing sustained 5xx + queue growth. Trying a small cache flush and routing reduction to fallback pool.
Priya: DRAFT statuspage copy below — please review quickly and flag any legal/localization issues.
```
We are currently experiencing elevated error rates and delayed response times for model generation requests in EU-West. Impact: approx. 15-25% of generation requests may return errors or increased latencies.
Action: Our on-call team is investigating and has applied routing workarounds to reduce customer impact. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
Affected services: Text generation (hosted API), streaming endpoints.
Region: eu-west-1
Customer impact: intermittent errors and slower completions; no data loss reported.
ETA: under investigation.
```
Marcus: small wording suggestion — change first line to "experiencing degraded generation availability" and add "workaround: routing to fallback model variant applied" in actions. Also include link to status doc: https://go.redwood/status/incidents/genqueue-1768
Priya: updated draft with Marcus edits. New copy pasted below.
```
We are currently experiencing degraded generation availability in EU-West. Impact: ~15-25% of generation requests may return errors or see increased latency. Workaround: traffic is being routed to a fallback model variant to reduce errors; KV cache has been warmed.
We will provide updates every 15 minutes. No customer data loss has been detected.
```
Sam: Legal quick check — initial public language is fine. Do not speculate on root cause. Keep "under investigation" and avoid timelines. :thumbsup:
Priya: noted. L10n needed for DE/FR/JP. @Lenea can you take quick pass?
Lenea: I’ll do DE/FR now, can have short localized strings in ~20m. Will ping when ready. :eyes:
Priya: ok plan: Marcus will publish the initial status update, include the workaround line, and set cadence to 15m. I will hand off on-call at :20 UTC to Marcus (brief below).
Priya: ONCALL HANDOFF NOTE: mitigations applied — routing to fallback model, cleared KV cache on eu-west pool, temporary rate-limit increase for streaming endpoints. Monitoring shows error rate dropping but still above baseline. Logs: `genqueue.errors > 5%` earlier but now ~2.3%.
Marcus: I will publish initial update now and take ownership. Will schedule follow-ups at +15m and +30m. Who should I copy for customer notifications if this extends >1h? @Sam? @CustomerSuccess?
Sam: copy CS + growth PMs. If we hit >30% customer impact escalate to exec comms.
ops-runbook-bot: Statuspage update published by Marcus at 1768429942. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/genqueue-1768429876/initial
Marcus: published. Monitoring panels show improvement but still tracking. Next update scheduled 15m.
Priya: handing off to Marcus now — thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Marcus: taking over. Will post periodic rollups and coordinate any customer notify drafts.
Marcus: 15m UPDATE (published): error rate down to ~1.6%, latency still slightly elevated for some long-context requests. Continuing health checks.
Marcus: RESOLVED UPDATE DRAFT: Service returned to normal for all regions. Root cause under investigation; engineering will follow up with an RCA. No customer data exposure was observed. Please reopen if you see regressions.
ops-runbook-bot: Resolved statuspage update published by Marcus at 1768430098. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/genqueue-1768429876/resolved
Priya: thanks everyone. Leaving a short post-incident note in #postmortems with mitigations and next steps.
Marcus: will file RCA ticket and ping stakeholders.
